description: Canonical loop-governance cron jobs. Managed by install-crons.py.

crons.name: skill-miner
crons.description: Mines local data (sessions, loop DB, memory) for patterns, sends top findings to Moses via inbox. Runs Monday 6am.

crons.name: weekly-loop-evaluation
crons.prompt:
Run the loop governance evaluation pipeline for the last 7 days, then run the skill miner, auto-apply safe config changes, and vacuum old cycles.

1. Generate the evaluation report using the loop-governance skill (last 7 days).
2. Run the skill miner: execute `skill-miner` and report findings (auto-apply ready, needs review, discarded).
3. Run auto-apply: execute `auto-apply --json`. Report what was applied or skipped.
4. Run DB retention (archive cycles older than 90 days).
5. Deliver a combined message.
crons.description: Weekly evaluation — report, skill miner, auto-apply safe patches, vacuum old cycles.
